protocol: warmup 10000 + median of 5 runs x 1000000 sequential get_providers() calls per face; set_providers replays the wrapper's run-time EPFail fallback call (:301) verbatim

runtime_epfail_fallback_observability.note: wrapper run() catches C.EPFail, calls set_providers(_fallback_providers), disables fallback and re-runs returning NORMALLY (no exception reaches the caller); the provider-list change IS observable via the public get_providers() afterwards

one_percent_budget_check.unit_note: 口径=单次原语 get_providers() 调用（P4-6）；1% 预算=基准页时延的 1%（1.106 s × 1% = 11,060 μs），r1 P2-1 前版误用整页微秒数
one_percent_budget_check.verdict: PASS: 稳态每页一次 get_providers() 读回的时延增量低于 1% 硬门

wording_discipline: directional 证据；禁用「显著」；数字如实登记不作质量判定
